notes: word2md.com (benbalter/word-to-markdown-js): an Astro static site. Node 26.13.0 is pinned in mise.toml, and the site is built with `npm ci && npm run build`; dist/ is copied to .ui-capture/out (.ui-capture/build.sh reproduces all of this). Conversion runs entirely in the browser through a module Web Worker (mammoth -> turndown -> markdownlint -> prettier). There is no backend, account or stored state: no localStorage or IndexedDB, and nothing is uploaded. So 'established use' means the documents a regular user converts. .ui-capture/samples/ holds 21 realistic .docx files from one user's Documents folder (Priya Raman, ops lead at a small transit nonprofit). They are dated May–Nov 2026 via file mtimes and include a board report with budget tables and a footnote, an incident postmortem, a driver handbook with nested numbered lists, weekly meeting notes, a grant narrative with footnotes, a redlined data-sharing agreement with strikethrough, a resume, a short letter and more. There is also one legacy 'Old bylaws (2014).doc', which the app rejects with its own message. They were generated by .ui-capture/gen-samples.mjs (content in sample-docs.mjs) using the repo's scripts/lib/docx-from-spec.mjs and round-tripped through the real converter; the expected .md for each sits beside it. Load them through the app's own drop zone or file input (input[type=file], multiple allowed, up to 20 per batch). Main areas: / is the landing page with the hero, the drop zone (also accepts pasted rich text), How it works, the conversion comparison table and the FAQ. After one file you get a 'Converted <name>' header, Copy Markdown / Download .md / Convert another, and side-by-side Markdown source and rendered preview panels, plus any warnings. After 2+ files a batch list appears with per-file selection, error rows and 'Download all (.zip)'. Other pages: /privacy/, /terms/, /developers/, /google-docs-to-markdown/, /docx-to-markdown-for-llms/, and 22 localized home pages (/de/, /ja/, /ar/ (RTL), ...). Checked in headless Chromium at 1440x900: fonts load, single and batch conversions work, and there are no console errors.
